author: Unreal Engine
description:
Learn how Epic Games and The Third Floor collaborated to shape the animation approach for The Lost Chapter: Yuki’s Revenge using Unreal Engine. This deep dive breaks down how animating on twos, real-time iteration, and cinematic lighting were used to define a distinct visual style. 

Learn more about the making of The Lost Chapter: Yuki’s Revenge: https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/spotlights/step-behind-the-camera-of-quentin-tarantinos-the-lost-chapter-yukis-revenge

title: Yuki’s Revenge | Animating The Lost Chapter

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Ready to step into the world of real-time production? Aaron Gordon, Co-Founder of Synapse Virtual Production, shares what students need to know if they’re considering a career in virtual production and real-time media creation.

In this interview, Aaron discusses the reality of working in media & entertainment —where film, broadcast, and interactive experiences intersect. He offers practical advice for recent graduates on how to embrace being a generalist and why transmedia skills are essential.

Interested in working at a leading creative visualization studio? James Falconer from The Boundary explains how the real estate industry is adopting new real-time workflows, including virtual production, and why students and recent graduates need broad, adaptable skill sets to succeed.

Learn about the emerging technologies and workflows shaping the industry, and discover how to apply real-time skills to high-end digital twin projects.
